title: Low-Cal Tofu Gado Gado Salad
subtitle: with Baby Potatoes and Snow Peas
description: Inspired by Indonesian gado gado, this salad bowl is brimming with fresh and cooked veggies, protein-rich tofu and a delicious peanut dressing.

steps.text: Boil potatoes: Quarter the unpeeled potatoes, put in a medium saucepan of cold salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8-10 mins until tender. Drain and cool under cold running water.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the egg (see Kitchen 101). Trim the stems from the snow peas, removing the strings from one side, then thinly slice lengthwise. Thinly slice the cucumber. Coarsely chop the peanuts. Peel the carrot, then shred using a julienne peeler or coarsely grate with a box grater.

Boil egg and warm tofu: Cook 1 egg in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins for soft-boiled, or 8 mins for hard-boiled. Drain, then cool in cold water. Meanwhile, heat a small frypan over medium heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan and thinly slice.
Make dressing: Combine 3 tsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp soy sauce, 3 tsp water and a pinch of chilli flakes, if using, in a bowl. Add half the peanuts and stir to combine. Peel and quarter the egg.

Serve up: Divide the veggies, tofu and egg among bowls, drizzle with the dressing and scatter with the remaining peanuts. Season with salt and pepper, sprinkle with a pinch of chilli flakes, if desired, and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: If you have the time, remove your egg from the fridge and bring to room temperature prior to cooking, as it is less likely to crack during cooking and is easier to peel.
